resources.string: Ordinary point bubbles now show “Point N”, matching the Daily path.
Antipodes keep the original point’s name and number, including in captures.
Sky grids are black in the morning and afternoon in any weather, and white in other solar phases.
Panorama centre choices have compass icons with international N, E, S, W letters.
Lighter Sky and Globe panoramas when panning and zooming.
Optimized label handling, preserving visibility and selection rules.
